mcd22-1.flavorText: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

attacks.name: Wind Shard
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Sky Circus
abilities.text: If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs.

mcd22-2.flavorText: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

mcd22-3.flavorText: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Warm Up
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

mcd22-4.flavorText: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

attacks.name: Victory Dive
attacks.text: You may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

mcd22-5.flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

attacks.name: Wintry Call
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Melony cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

mcd22-6.flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

attacks.name: Energize
attacks.text: Attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

mcd22-7.flavorText: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

mcd22-8.flavorText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

mcd22-9.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

mcd22-10.flavorText: One alone can emit only trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

mcd22-11.flavorText: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

attacks.name: Split Spiral Punch
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

mcd22-12.flavorText: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

attacks.name: Knocking Hammer
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Shakedown
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

mcd22-13.flavorText: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

attacks.name: Berserk
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 90 more damage.

mcd22-14.flavorText: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

attacks.name: Live Painting
attacks.text: Reveal any number of basic Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 30 more damage for each type of basic Energy you revealed in this way.

mcd22-15.flavorText: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.
